# Clean patient roster

STEP 1: Create a flag indicator for patients on the roster - this is
useful later when merged with the patient detail to indicate who is on
the roster. We later only retain children active on the roster.

STEP 2: Create a calculated variable for age in years and age in months.

IMPORTANT! Make sure the "age as of" date matches your intended date,
the same you used to the reports out of WebIZ.

STEP 3: Create age groups - depending on what you need

STEP 4: Filter (remove) anyone who is not in the age group(s) of
interest.

## !!!! UPDATE AS OF DATE AS NEEDED !!!!

```{r clean roster, include=FALSE}

#Set the "age as of" date. For example, age 19 - 35 months *as of January 1, 2026*

age_as_of_date <- ymd("2026-06-01")

roster2 <- roster %>% 
  mutate(
    roster = 1,   # Step 1: Create a "flag" for if the child is on the roster
    
    # Step 2: "Parse" DOB, calculate age in months, and age in years
    age_months = floor(time_length(interval(dob, age_as_of_date), "months")),
    age_years  = floor(time_length(interval(dob, age_as_of_date), "years")),
    
# Step 3: Assign age group - first date is the DOB of the oldest kid in the cohort, second date is the DOB of the youngest kid in the cohort. Use the same DOB range you used to run the patient detail with services.

    agegroup = case_when(
      age_months >= 2 & age_months < 4 ~ 1,
      age_months >= 4 & age_months < 6 ~ 2,
      age_months >= 6 & age_months < 12 ~ 3,
      age_months >= 12 & age_months < 19 ~ 4,
      age_months >= 19 & age_months < 36 ~ 5,
      age_months >= 36 & age_months < 48 ~ 6,
      age_months >= 48 & age_months < 60 ~ 7,
      age_months >= 60 & age_months < 72 ~ 8,
      age_months >= 72 & age_months < 84 ~ 9,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )%>% 
  
  # Step 4: Filter out those not in the age group(s) of interest
  filter(!is.na(agegroup))

```

# Clean patient reminder/recall

STEP 1: Create a flag indicator for patients on the reminder.

STEP 2: Create a calculated variable for age in years and age in months.

IMPORTANT! Make sure the "age as of" date matches your intended date,
the same you used to the reports out of WebIZ.

STEP 3: Create age groups - depending on what you need.

STEP 4: Filter (remove) anyone who is not in the age group(s) of
interest.

## !!!! UPDATE AS OF DATE AS NEEDED !!!!

```{r reminder2, include=FALSE}
#Set the "age as of" date. For example, age 19 - 35 months *as of January 1, 2026*

age_as_of_date <- ymd("2026-06-01")

reminder2 <- reminder %>% 
  mutate(
    onreminder = 1,   # Step 1: Create a "flag" for if the child is on the roster
    
    # Step 2: "Parse" DOB, calculate age in months, and age in years
    age_months = floor(time_length(interval(dob, age_as_of_date), "months")),
    age_years  = floor(time_length(interval(dob, age_as_of_date), "years")),
    
# Step 3: Assign age group - first date is the DOB of the oldest kid in the cohort, second date is the DOB of the youngest kid in the cohort. Use the same DOB range you used to run the patient detail with services.

#In this case, creating age groups for 2 - 59 months (note there is a 19-35 month catgeory)

    rr_agegroup = case_when(
      age_months >= 2 & age_months < 4 ~ 1,
      age_months >= 4 & age_months < 6 ~ 2,
      age_months >= 6 & age_months < 12 ~ 3,
      age_months >= 12 & age_months < 19 ~ 4,
      age_months >= 19 & age_months < 36 ~ 5,
      age_months >= 36 & age_months < 48 ~ 6,
      age_months >= 48 & age_months < 60 ~ 7,
      age_months >= 60 & age_months < 72 ~ 8,
      age_months >= 72 & age_months < 84 ~ 9,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )%>% 
  
  #Rename county to rr_county so that we can retain the patient roster county and the reminder/recall county in the final dataset (because they are often different and we can use both for better cleaning)
  
  mutate(county = toupper(county)) %>%
  rename(rr_county = county) %>%

  # Step 4: Filter out those not in the age group(s) of interest
  filter(!is.na(rr_agegroup))


```

# Create reminder categories

STEP 1: Parse out vaccine types

STEP 2: Determine whether the dose is considered "final" based on age

STEP 3: Create categorizations for delinquency according to the
recommended schedule

```{r recs, include=FALSE}

reminder3 <- reminder2 %>%
  # Keep only children 2-83 months
  filter(age_months >= 2, age_months <= 83) %>%
  # Temporary row ID so we can safely collapse back later
  mutate(row_id = row_number())

# --- Step A: Parse recommendations into one row per recommended dose ---
processed_doses <- reminder3 %>%
  select(row_id, patient_id, age_months, immunization_recommendations) %>%
  mutate(
    matches = str_extract_all(
      immunization_recommendations,
      regex("(DTAP|HEPB|HIB|MMR/MEASLES|PNEUMOCOCCAL|POLIO)\\s*\\(\\d+\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(matches) %>%
  mutate(
    vaccine = str_to_upper(str_extract(matches, "^[A-Z/]+")),
    dose    = as.numeric(str_extract(matches, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  # Ignore HepB(4)
  filter(!(vaccine == "HEPB" & dose == 4)) %>%
  
  # --- Step B: Flag whether each recommended dose is a "final dose" for that age ---
  mutate(
    is_final = case_when(
      
      # 2-3 months: 1 DTaP, 1 IPV, 1 Hib, 2 HepB, 1 PCV
      age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 3 ~ case_when(
        vaccine == "DTAP"         & dose == 1 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "POLIO"        & dose == 1 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HIB"          & dose == 1 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HEPB"         & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "PNEUMOCOCCAL" & dose == 1 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      
      # 4-5 months: 2 DTaP, 2 IPV, 2 Hib, 2 HepB, 2 PCV
      age_months >= 4 & age_months <= 5 ~ case_when(
        vaccine == "DTAP"         & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "POLIO"        & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HIB"          & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HEPB"         & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "PNEUMOCOCCAL" & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      
      # 6-11 months: 3 DTaP, 3 IPV, 2 Hib, 3 HepB, 3 PCV
      age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 11 ~ case_when(
        vaccine == "DTAP"         & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "POLIO"        & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HIB"          & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HEPB"         & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "PNEUMOCOCCAL" & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      
      # 12-18 months: 4 DTaP, 3 IPV, 1 MMR, 3 Hib, 3 HepB, 4 PCV
      age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 18 ~ case_when(
        vaccine == "DTAP"         & dose == 4 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "POLIO"        & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "MMR/MEASLES"  & dose == 1 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HIB"          & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HEPB"         & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "PNEUMOCOCCAL" & dose == 4 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      
      # 19-47 months: 4 DTaP, 3 IPV, 2 MMR, Hib(any), 3 HepB, PCV(any)
      age_months >= 19 & age_months <= 47 ~ case_when(
        vaccine == "DTAP"         & dose == 4 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "POLIO"        & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "MMR/MEASLES"  & dose == 2 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HIB"                    ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HEPB"         & dose == 3 ~ 1,
        vaccine == "PNEUMOCOCCAL"           ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      
      # 48-83 months: 4 or 5 DTaP, 4 or 3 IPV, 2 MMR, Hib(any), 3 HepB, PCV(any)
      age_months >= 48 & age_months <= 83 ~ case_when(
        vaccine == "DTAP"         & dose %in% c(4, 5) ~ 1,
        vaccine == "POLIO"        & dose %in% c(3, 4) ~ 1,
        vaccine == "MMR/MEASLES"  & dose == 2         ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HIB"                              ~ 1,
        vaccine == "HEPB"         & dose == 3         ~ 1,
        vaccine == "PNEUMOCOCCAL"                     ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# --- Step C: Count final vs nonfinal recommended doses ---
dose_counts <- processed_doses %>%
  group_by(row_id) %>%
  summarise(
    final_count    = sum(is_final == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    nonfinal_count = sum(is_final == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Step D: Join back and classify how far behind the child is ---
reminder3 <- reminder3 %>%
  left_join(dose_counts, by = "row_id") %>%
  mutate(
    final_count    = replace_na(final_count, 0),
    nonfinal_count = replace_na(nonfinal_count, 0),

    RR_category = case_when(
      final_count == 0 & nonfinal_count == 0 ~ 99,
      nonfinal_count > 0                     ~ 3,  # Missing more than a final dose
      final_count == 1                       ~ 1,  # Missing only 1 final dose
      final_count >= 2                       ~ 2,  # Missing 2+ final doses
      TRUE                                   ~ 99
    ),

    rr_subcategory = case_when(
      RR_category == 99 ~ "No recommendations after filters",
      RR_category == 3  ~ "Missing more than a final dose",
      RR_category == 1  ~ "Missing only 1 final dose",
      RR_category == 2  ~ "Missing 2 or more final doses"
    ),

    rr_miss_cat = case_when(
      RR_category == 99 ~ "No recommendations",
      RR_category == 3  ~ "2) Missing more than a final dose",
      RR_category == 1  ~ "1a) Missing only 1 final dose",
      RR_category == 2  ~ "1b) Missing 2 or more final doses"
    ),

    age_band = case_when(
      age_months >= 2  & age_months <= 3  ~ "2-3 months",
      age_months >= 4  & age_months <= 5  ~ "4-5 months",
      age_months >= 6  & age_months <= 11 ~ "6-11 months",
      age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 18 ~ "12-18 months",
      age_months >= 19 & age_months <= 47 ~ "19-47 months",
      age_months >= 48 & age_months <= 59 ~ "48-59 months",
      age_months >= 60 & age_months <= 71 ~ "60-71 months",
      age_months >= 72 & age_months <= 83 ~ "72-83 months",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id, primary_contact_lastname_firstname, age_months, onreminder, rr_county,
    address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, zip,
    immunization_recommendations,
    final_count, nonfinal_count,
    RR_category, rr_subcategory
  )

# Preview
head(reminder3)

```

# Determine which vaccine types are needed based on reminder/recall

Determine specific product types per child based on recommendations

```{r recs2, include=FALSE}

#Determine which vaccines are needed based on the reminder

reminder4 <- reminder3 %>%
  mutate(
    
    # --- Basic vaccine recommendation flags ---
    
    # MMR IS DONE LATER BECAUSE DOSE 2 FOR CHILDREN UNDER 4 AREN'T ON RR
    
    need_dtap = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                           regex("DTAP\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_dtap123 = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                           regex("DTAP\\s*\\((1|2|3)\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_hepb = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                           regex("HEPB\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_ipv = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                          regex("POLIO\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_ipv123 = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                             regex("POLIO\\s*\\((1|2|3)\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_hib = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                          regex("HIB\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_hib4 = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                           regex("HIB\\s*\\(4\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_hib123 = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                             regex("HIB\\s*\\((1|2|3)\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_pcv = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                          regex("PNEUMOCOCCAL\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    need_rota = str_detect(immunization_recommendations,
                           regex("ROTAVIRUS\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    # --- Product indicators ---
      vaxelis_antigen_count =
      as.integer(need_dtap123) +
      as.integer(need_ipv123) +
      as.integer(need_hib123) +
      as.integer(need_hepb),

    pediarix_antigen_count =
      as.integer(need_dtap123) +
      as.integer(need_ipv123) +
      as.integer(need_hepb),
    
  # --- Product indicators (Yes/No) ---

Vaxelis = if_else(
  need_hib123 & vaxelis_antigen_count >= 2 &
    !(need_hib123 & !need_dtap & !need_ipv & !need_hepb),
  1, 0
),

Pediarix = if_else(
  (need_hib4 | !need_hib) &
    pediarix_antigen_count >= 2 &
    Vaxelis == 0,
  1, 0
),

   PedVaxHib = if_else(
  need_hib4 |
    (need_hib123 & Vaxelis == 0 & Pediarix == 0),
  1, 0
),

DTaP_Single = if_else(
  need_dtap & Vaxelis == 0 & Pediarix == 0,
  1, 0
),

IPV_Single = if_else(
  need_ipv & Vaxelis == 0 & Pediarix == 0,
  1, 0
),

    Prevnar    = if_else(need_pcv, 1,0),
    RotaTeq    = if_else(need_rota, 1,0)
  ) %>%
  select(-vaxelis_antigen_count, -pediarix_antigen_count)

# Preview
head(reminder4)

```

# Transpose vaccine data

STEP 1: Transpose vaccine data using CVX codes. This transposes the
patient detail list using vaccination_code_id to get one line per
patient with all vaccine history.

Step 2: Filter data to only include the selected vaccine types (e.g.,
DTaP) using the all relevant cvx code(s) that include that vaccine type.

Step 3: Select needed variables

Step 4: Group by patient name

Step 5: Create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination
dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.

Step 6: Reshape data from the default long format to a wide format -
putting all the vaccine dates for an individual patient record one line.

NOTE 1: FSM vaccines: BCG, DTaP, IPV, MMR, Hib, HepB, PCV, Rota

NOTE 2: Check CVX codes for each vaccine to make sure none are missing
or added to the wrong vaccine

NOTE 3: Calculating the number of doses by antigen will be completed
later

```{r transpose vaccine data, include=FALSE}

# STEP 1 transpose vaccine data using cvx codes. This transposes the patient detail list using vaccination_code_id to get one line per patient with all vaccine history. 
################## BCG ##################
bcg <- detail2 %>% 
    # filter data to only include selected vaccine using the correct cvx code(s)
    filter(vaccination_code_id == "19") %>% 
    # select needed variables
    select (patient_name, gender, vaccination_date) %>% 
    # group by patient name
    group_by(patient_name) %>% 
    # create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>% 
    # reshape data from the default long format to a wide format 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_name, gender), names_from = row_id, values_from = vaccination_date, names_prefix= "bcg_date") 

################## DTAP ##################
dtap <- detail2 %>% 
    # filter data to only include selected vaccine using the correct cvx code(s)
    filter(vaccination_code_id %in% c("1","20","22","28","50","102","106","107","110","120","130","132","146","170","198")) %>%
    # select needed variables
    select (patient_name, gender, vaccination_date) %>% 
    # group by patient name
    group_by(patient_name) %>% 
    # create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>% 
    # reshape data from the default long format to a wide format 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_name, gender), names_from = row_id, values_from = vaccination_date, names_prefix= "dtap_date")

################## IPV ##################
ipv <- detail2 %>% 
    # filter data to only include selected vaccine using the correct cvx code(s)
    filter(vaccination_code_id %in% c("2","10","89","110","120","130","132","146","170","178","179","182","195")) %>%
    # select needed variables
    select (patient_name, gender, vaccination_date) %>% 
    # group by patient name
    group_by(patient_name) %>% 
    # create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>% 
    # reshape data from the default long format to a wide format 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_name, gender), names_from = row_id, values_from = vaccination_date, names_prefix= "ipv_date")

################## MMR ##################
mmr <- detail2 %>% 
    # filter data to only include selected vaccine using the correct cvx code(s)
    filter(vaccination_code_id %in% c("3","94")) %>%
    # select needed variables
    select (patient_name, gender, vaccination_date) %>% 
    # group by patient name
    group_by(patient_name) %>% 
    # create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.

    # reshape data from the default long format to a wide format 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_name, gender), names_from = row_id, values_from = vaccination_date, names_prefix= "mmr_date")

################## HEPB ##################
hepb <- detail2 %>% 
    # filter data to only include selected vaccine using the correct cvx code(s)
    filter(vaccination_code_id %in% c("8","42","43","44","45","51","102","104","110","132","146","189","193","198","220")) %>%
    # select needed variables
    select (patient_name, gender, vaccination_date) %>% 
    # group by patient name

    # create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>% 
    # reshape data from the default long format to a wide format 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_name, gender), names_from = row_id, values_from = vaccination_date, names_prefix= "hepb_date")

################## PCV ##################
pcv <- detail2 %>% 
    # filter data to only include selected vaccine using the correct cvx code(s)
    filter(vaccination_code_id %in% c("33","100","109","133","152","177","215","216")) %>%
    # select needed variables
    select (patient_name, gender, vaccination_date) %>% 
    # group by patient name
    group_by(patient_name) %>% 
    # create row identifier to distinguishing multiple vaccination dates for patients who may have received more than one dose.
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
```

# JOIN ROSTER2, REMINDER4, AND DETAIL4

Remove patients with missing patient_id

Join roster and detail first, clean, then join reminder

STEP 1: Use full join to merge roster2, reminder4, and detail4, by
patient id

STEP 2: Complete flags for records missing in roster, detail by making
the flag 0 if it's missing

STEP 3: Create birth cohort year

STEP 4: Clean gender

STEP 5: Make county uppercase

STEP 6: Subset to only include active patients

```{r merge detail3 and roster2, include=FALSE}

roster2 <- roster2 %>%
  mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))

reminder4 <- reminder4 %>%
  mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))

detail4 <- detail4 %>%
  mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id))

#STEP 1: use full join to merge roster2 and detail 4, by patient id
clean <- full_join(roster2, detail4, by= c("patient_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    #STEP 2: create flags for data that is missing in roster and detail
    roster=ifelse(is.na(roster), 0, 1),
    ondetail=ifelse(is.na(ondetail), 0, 1),
    
    #STEP 3: create birth cohort based on year of birth
    birth_cohort = year(dob),
    
    #STEP 4: clean gender variable
    gender = case_when(
      gender %in% c("Transgender", "Unknown", NA) ~ "Unknown/Missing",
      TRUE ~ gender),  # Keep the original value for other cases
    
    #STEP 5: make county uppercase
    county = toupper(county)
  ) %>% #mutate close
  
  #STEP 6: subset to only include active patients 
  subset(., clinic_status == "ACTIVE") 

```

```{r merge reminder3 and clean, include=FALSE}
#STEP 1: use full join to merge clean and reminder4, by patient id
clean2 <- full_join(
  clean,
  reminder4 %>% select(-age_months),
  by = "patient_id"
) %>%
  mutate(
    roster    = ifelse(is.na(roster), 0, 1),
    onreminder = ifelse(is.na(onreminder), 0, 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(roster == 1)

```

# Merge clean data frame and Hib

NOTE: This clean dataset needs to match main clean dataset that is
created later in main code!

STEP 1: Use full join to merge roster2 and hib, by patient id

STEP 2: Complete flags for records missing in roster, detail

STEP 3: Make county variable values upper case

STEP 4: Create birth cohort year

STEP 5: Clean gender

STEP 6: Make county uppercase

STEP 7: Subset to only include active patients

STEP 8: Remove unwanted variables

```{r merge hib and roster2, include=FALSE}

#STEP 1: use full join to merge roster2 and hib, by patient id
clean_hib <- full_join(roster2, hib, by= c("patient_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    #STEP 2: create flags for data that is missing in roster and detail
    roster=ifelse(is.na(roster), 0, 1),
    detail=ifelse(is.na(detail), 0, 1),
    #STEP 3: clean variable names that have been duplicated
    dob = coalesce(dob.x, dob.y),
    agegroup = coalesce(agegroup.x, agegroup.y),
    hospital_id = coalesce(hospital_id.x, hospital_id.y),
    #STEP 4: create birth cohort year
    birth_cohort = year(dob),
    #STEP 5: clean gender
    gender = case_when(
      gender %in% c("Transgender", "Unknown", NA) ~ "Unknown/Missing",
      TRUE ~ gender),  # Keep the original value for other cases
    #STEP 6: make county uppercase
    county = toupper(county)
  ) %>% #mutate close
  #STEP 7: subset to only include active patients 
  subset(., clinic_status == "ACTIVE") %>% 
  #STEP 8: remove unwanted variables
  select(-dob.x, -dob.y, -agegroup.x, -agegroup.y, -hospital_id.x, -hospital_id.y)

```

# ADD dose number column

STEP 1: Sort by patient_id and vaccination_date

STEP 2: Group by patient_id

STEP 3: Increment dose number unless vaccination date is na

STEP 4: Calculate age at dose in days

STEP 5: Convert days to months

STEP 6: Drop unnecessary variables

NOTE: The use of ungroup() is a good practice in data manipulation
workflows when working with grouped data frames in R's tidyverse. It
ensures that subsequent operations are performed on the entire dataset
rather than within groups unless explicitly intended.

```{r hib dose number, include=FALSE}
clean_hib2 <- clean_hib %>%
  mutate(
  ) %>%
  #STEP 1: sort by patient_id and vaccination_date
  arrange(patient_id, vaccination_date) %>%  
  #STEP 2: group by patient_id
  group_by(patient_id) %>%                   
  mutate(
    dose_number = ifelse(is.na(vaccination_date), NA, 
                         #STEP 3: increment dose number unless vaccination date is na
                         cumsum(!is.na(vaccination_date))), 
     #STEP 4: calculate age at dose in days
    age_dose_days = as.numeric(vaccination_date - dob),  
    #STEP 5: convert days to months
    age_dose_mos = floor(age_dose_days / 30.41667) 
  ) %>%
  # see note
  ungroup() %>%
  #STEP 6: drop unnecessary variables
  select(-created_by,
         -hl7_facility_code,
         -last_updated_date_time,
         -patient_default_clinic_v_trck_s_pin,
         -lot_num, -expiration_date, -funding_source,
         -age, -inactive_reason, -patient_name,
         -history_only, -invalid_only,
         -vaccine_manufacturer, -vaccine_clinic_v_trck_s_pin) 


```

# Create product flags

STEP 1: Set dose_number and vaccination_code_id for kids on roster with
no dose

STEP 2: Create product variable based on conditions

```{r hib flag product names and no hib doses, include=FALSE}
clean_hib4 <- clean_hib3 %>%
  mutate(
    #STEP 1: set dose_number and vaccination_code_id for kids on roster with no dose
    dose_number = ifelse(is.na(vaccination_date), 99, dose_number),
    vaccination_code_id = ifelse(is.na(vaccination_date), "99", vaccination_code_id),
    vaccination_code = ifelse(is.na(vaccination_date), "no dose", vaccination_code),
    
    #STEP 2: create product variable based on conditions
    product = case_when(
      vaccination_code_id == "99" ~ "none",
      vaccination_code_id == "49" ~ "pedvaxhib",
      TRUE ~ "ahpvuo" #ahpvuo=ActHIB, Hiberix,Pentacel, Vaxelis, Unknown, Other 
    ) #case close
  ) #mutate close
```

# County Cleaning

STEP 1: clean provider variable

STEP 2: clean county variable

STEP 3: create state variable

STEP 4: create region variable

STEP 5: complete cleaning region

STEP 6: complete identifying state

STEP 7: complete identifying county

STEP 8: revert data set name to clean2

```{r cleaning counties, include=FALSE}
####################################
#    STEP 1:  cleaning providers   #
####################################

clean3 <- clean2 %>%
 
  # 2. Ensure columns exist and are character types (replacing SAS LENGTH/FORMAT)
  mutate(
    # clinic = as.character(if("clinic" %in% names(.)) clinic else NA),
    # county = as.character(if("county" %in% names(.)) county else NA),
    # city = as.character(if("city" %in% names(.)) city else NA),
    # state  = as.character(if("state" %in% names(.)) state else NA),
    region = as.character(if("region" %in% names(.)) region else NA),
    # provider = as.character(provider),
    
    # Replace R NAs with empty strings "" to match SAS behavior for string comparisons below
     across(c(region), ~replace_na(., ""))
   ) %>%

  # --- CLEANING PROVIDERS ---
  mutate(
    provider = case_when(
      provider %in% c("POHNPEI FAMILY  HEALTH CLINIC", 
                      "POHNPEI FAMILY HEALTH CLINIC", 
                      "FSM NATIONAL IMMUNIZATION OFFICE", 
                      "GENESIS HOSPITAL") ~ "POHNPEI STATE",
      TRUE ~ provider
    )
  ) %>%

  # --- INITIAL COUNTY CLEANING ---
  mutate(
    county = case_when(
      county == "UNKNOWN" ~ rr_county,
      county %in% c("MORTLOCK", "NORTHWEST") ~ city,
      is.na(county) ~ city,
      TRUE ~ county
    )
  ) %>%
 
 mutate( 
  city = case_when(
      is.na(city)  ~ county,
      TRUE ~ city
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # --- DETAILED VILLAGE CLEANING  ---
  mutate(
    city = case_when(
      
  #Chuuk villages 
      state == "CH" & city == "FANIF" ~ "FANIP",
      city == "EOT" ~ "EOT ISLAND",
      city == "ETTAL" ~ "ETAL",
      city == "FANANU" ~ "FANANU ISLAND",
      city == "KUTTU" ~ "KUTU ISLAND",
      city == "LOSAP" ~ "LOSAP ISLAND",
      city == "MAKUR" ~ "MAGUR ISLAND",
      city == "MURILO" ~ "MURILO ATOLL",
      city == "NOMWIN" ~ "NOMWIN ISLAND",
      city == "ONARI" ~ "ONARI ISLAND",
      city == "ONO" ~ "ONO ISLAND",
      city == "ONEI" ~ "WONEI",
      city == "PAREM-CHUUK" ~ "PAREM",
      city == "POLLE-PPO" ~ "POLLE",
      city == "PPO-POLLE" ~ "POLLE",
      city == "POLLE=PPO" ~ "POLLE",
      city == "POLLAP" ~ "PULAP",
      city == "POLOWAT" ~ "PULUWAT",
      city == "PIIS PANEU" ~ "PIIS MOEN",
      city == "PISEMWAR" ~ "PISEMEW",
      city == "PIISEMWAR" ~ "PISEMEW",
      city == "PPO-PAATA" ~ "PATA",
      city == "PPO-ONEI" ~ "WONEI",
      city == "SAPETIW" ~ "SAPOTIW",
      city == "SOPOTIW" ~ "SAPOTIW",
      city == "TOLENSOM" ~ "TOL",
      city == "TUNNUK" ~ "TUNUK",
      city == "NEIRENON-NEPPI" ~ "NEIRENOM",
      city == "NEIRENON-PENIENUK" ~ "PENIENUK",
      city == "ROMALUM" ~ "ROMONUM",
      city == "TAA" ~ "TA",
      
    #Yap
     city == "DALIPEBINAW" ~ "DALIPEEBINAEW",
     city == "RULL" ~ "RUUL",
     city == "ELATO" ~ "ELATO ISLAND",
     city == "LAMOTREK" ~ "LAMOTREK ISLAND",
     city == "LAMORREK" ~ "LAMOTREK ISLAND",
     city == "TOMIL" ~ "TAMIL",
     city == "TAFNITH" ~ "TAFGIF",
     city == "ULITHI" ~ "ULITHI ATOLL",
     city == "WELOY" ~ "WEELOEY",
     
    
    #Kosrae
    city == "LELU" ~ "LELU ISLAND",
    city == "UTWE" ~ "UTWA",
    
    #Pohnpei
     city == "PINGILAP" ~ "PINGELAP",
     
    
     TRUE ~ city
    )
  ) %>%

  
  # --- DETAILED COUNTY CLEANING  ---
  mutate(
    county = case_when(
      
  #Chuuk counties 
      county == "CHK_TOL" ~ "TOLENSOM",
      county == "EOT" ~ "EOT ISLAND",
      county == "ETTAL" ~ "ETAL",
      county %in% c("CHK_TONOAS", "ETTEN") ~ "TONOAS",
      county %in% c("CHK-UDOT", "UDOT-TUNNUK") ~ "UDOT",
      county == "CHK_UMAN" ~ "UMAN",
      county == "ONEI" ~ "WONEI",
      county == "ONO" ~ "ONOUN",
      county == "ONARI" ~ "UNANU",
      county == "PAREM-CHUUK" ~ "PAREM",
      county == "PIIS PANEW" ~ "PIIS PANEU",
      county == "PISEMWAR" ~ "PIISEMWAR",
      county %in% c("ONEI", "PPO-ONEISOM", "PPO-ONEI") ~ "ONEI",
      county == "POLLE-PPO" ~ "POLLE",
      county == "POLLE=PPO" ~ "POLLE",
      county == "PPO-POLLE" ~ "POLLE",
      county == "PPO-PAATA" ~ "PATTA",
      county == "POLLAP" ~ "PULAP",
      county == "POLOWAT" ~ "PULUWAT",
      county == "ROMALUM" ~ "ROMONUM",
      county == "SAPETIW" ~ "SAPOTIW",
      county == "SOPOTIW" ~ "SAPOTIW",
      county == "TAA" ~ "TA",
      
      county %in% c("CCHC", "CCHC CHUUK", "CHUUK STATE L&D",  
                    "IRAS", "MECHITIW", "MWAN", "NEAUO", "NEPUKOS",                                           "PENIESENE", "TUNNUK", "WICHAP") ~ "WENO",
      
  #Kosrae counties
    county %in% c("KOSRAE HD", "KOSRAE STATE PUBLIC HEALTH") ~   
                  "LELU",
  
    county == "UTWA" ~ "UTWE",

   #Pohnpei counties
      county %in% c("WONE DISPENSARY", "WONE") ~ "KITTI",
      
      county %in% c("GENESIS HOSPITAL", "POHNPEI COMMUNITY HEALTH  
                    CENTER", "POHNPEI  PUBLIC HEALTH CLINIC", 
                    "PCHC", "POHNPEI HD", "POHNPEI LABOR AND 
                    DELIVERY", "POHNPEI PUBLIC HEALTH CLINIC") ~  
                    "KOLONIA",
      
      county %in% c("POHNLANGAS DISPENSARY", "POHNLANGAS", "LUKOP DISPENSARY", "LUKOP") ~                      "MADOLENIHMW",
      
      county == "SAPUK" ~ "SAPWUAHFIK",
      county %in% c("OROLUK", "SOKEHS DISPENSARY") ~ "SOKEHS",
      county == "U DISPENSARY" ~ "U",
 
  #Yap counties
      county == "DALIPEBINAW" ~ "DALIPEEBINAEW",
      county == "ELATO" ~ "ELATO ISLAND",
      county == "LAMORREK" ~ "LAMOTREK ISLAND",
      county == "LAMOTREK" ~ "LAMOTREK ISLAND",
      county == "RULL" ~ "RUUL",
      county == "SATAWAL-YAP" ~ "SATAWAL",
      county == "TOMIL" ~ "TAMIL",
      county == "WELOY" ~ "WEELOEY",
      county %in% c("ULITHI", "FECHAILAP", "SOROL") ~ "ULITHI ATOLL",
      county %in% c("COLONIA", "YAP STATE PUBLIC HEALTH") ~ "WELOY",
      
 # Specific logic override from SAS
      provider == "YAP STATE" & county == "TA" ~ "LAMOTREK",
      county %in% c("OUT-REACH", "OUTREACH", "GUAM IMMUNIZATION PROGRAM (AUTOMATED EXCHANGE)") ~ "UNKNOWN",
      
  TRUE ~ county
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # --- FILL COUNTY FROM CLINIC WHEN CITY, COUNTY, AND RR_COUNTY ARE ALL MISSING ---
  mutate(
    clinic_key = str_squish(str_to_upper(as.character(clinic))),
    
    county = case_when(
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "CHUUK STATE L&D" ~ "WENO",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "FEFAN" ~ "FEFAN",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "PPO-ONEI" ~ "WONEI",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "PPO-POLLE" ~ "POLLE",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "TOLENSOM" ~ "TOLENSOM",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "TONOAS" ~ "TONOAS",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "UDOT" ~ "UDOT",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "UMAN" ~ "UMAN",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "WENO" ~ "WENO",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "KOSRAE LABOR AND DELIVER" ~ "LELU",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "KOSRAE STATE PUBLIC HEALTH" ~ "LELU",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "MALEM" ~ "MALEM",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "TAFUNSAK" ~ "TAFUNSAK",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "GENESIS HOSPITAL" ~ "NETT",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "POHNPEI PUBLIC HEALTH CLINIC" ~ "NETT",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "POHNPEI COMMUNITY HEALTH CENTER" ~ "NETT",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "POHNPEI LABOR AND DELIVERY" ~ "NETT",
      
      (is.na(city) | str_squish(city) == "") &
        (is.na(county) | str_squish(county) == "") &
        (is.na(rr_county) | str_squish(rr_county) == "") &
        clinic_key == "YAP STATE PUBLIC HEALTH" ~ "MAAP",
      
      TRUE ~ county
    )
  ) %>%

  # --- FILTER OUT MISSING PATIENT IDs ---
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) %>% # SAS: IF Patient_ID=. THEN DELETE;

  # --- CLEAN STATE NAMES ---
  mutate(
    state = case_when(
      state == "CH" ~ "CHUUK",
      state == "KO" ~ "KOSRAE",
      state == "PO" ~ "POHNPEI",
      state == "YA" ~ "YAP",
      TRUE ~ state
    )
  ) %>%

  # --- ASSIGN REGIONS ---
  mutate(
    # Set default region first
    region = region, 
    
    # CHUUK LAGOON
    region = if_else(county %in% c("ETTEN", "EOT", "EOT ISLAND", "FANAPANGES", "FEFAN", "FONOTON","FONO","PAREM-CHUUK", "PIIS PANEU", "PPO-ONEI",  "ONEI", "WONEI", "PAATA", "PATA", "PPO-PATTA", "PPO-POLLE", "POLLE", "ROMALUM", "SAPOTA", "SAPOTIW", "SIIS", "TOLENSOM", "TONOAS", "UDOT", "UMAN"),  "LAGOON", region),
    
  state = if_else(county %in% c("ETTEN", "EOT", "FANAPANGES", "FEFAN", "FONOTON", "FONO", "PAREM-CHUUK", "PIIS PANEU", "PPO-ONEI", "PPO-PATTA", 
 "PPO-POLLE", "POLLE", "ROMALUM", "SAPOTIW", "SIIS", "TOLENSOM", 
  "TONOAS", "UDOT", "UMAN"), "CHUUK", state),

    # CHUUK MAIN
    region = if_else(county %in% c("WENO", "IRAS", "MWAN", "NEPUKOS", "PENIESENE", "WICHAP"), "MAIN", region),
    state  = if_else(county %in% c("WENO", "IRAS", "MWAN", "NEPUKOS", "PENIESENE", "WICHAP"), "CHUUK", state),

    # CHUUK OUTER
    region = if_else(county %in% c("ETTAL", "ETAL", "FANANU", "HOUK", "KUTTU", "LEKINIOCH",   "LOSAP", "MAKUR", "MOCH", "MORTLOCK", "MORTLOCKS", "MURILO", "NAMA", 
  "NAMOLUK", "NEAUO", "NOMWIN", "NORTHWEST", "ONEOP", "ONO", 
   "ONOUN", "PIHARAR", "PISEMWAR", "PIISEMWAR", "POLLAP", "PULAP",
   "POLOWAT", "RUO", "SATAWAN", "TA", "TAMATAM", "CHK_MORT", 
    "UNANU", "ONOU", "CHK_O"), "OUTER", region),
 
    state  = if_else(county %in% c("ETTAL", "FANANU", "HOUK", "KUTTU", "LEKINIOCH",  "LOSAP", "MAKUR", "MOCH", "MORTLOCK", "MORTLOCKS", "MURILO", "NAMA", 
 "NAMOLUK", "NEAUO", "NOMWIN", "NORTHWEST", "ONEOP", "ONO", 
 "ONOUN", "PIHARAR", "PISEMWAR", "PIISEMWAR", "POLLAP", 
 "POLOWAT", "RUO", "SATAWAN", "TA", "TAMATAM", "CHK_MORT", 
 "UNANU", "ONOU", "CHK_O"), "CHUUK", state),

    # KOSRAE MAIN
    region = if_else(county %in% c("LELU", "MALEM", "TAFUNSAK", "WALUNG", "UTWE"), "MAIN", region),
    state  = if_else(county %in% c("LELU", "MALEM", "TAFUNSAK", "WALUNG", "UTWE"), "KOSRAE", state),

    # POHNPEI MAIN
    region = if_else(county %in% c("KITTI", "KOLONIA", "LUKOP", "MADOLENIHMW", "NETT", "PCHC", "POHNLANGAS", "POHNPEI HD", "SOKEHS", "TUNNUK", "U", "WONE"), "MAIN", region),
    
    state  = if_else(county %in% c("KITTI", "KOLONIA", "LUKOP", "MADOLENIHMW", "NETT", "PCHC", "POHNLANGAS", "POHNPEI HD", "SOKEHS", "TUNNUK", "U", "WONE"), "POHNPEI", state),

    # POHNPEI OUTER
    region = if_else(county %in% c("KAPINGAMARANGI", "MWOAKILLOA", "NUKUORO", "PINGILAP", "SAPWUAHFIK"), "OUTER", region),
 
    state  = if_else(county %in% c("KAPINGAMARANGI", "MWOAKILLOA", "NUKUORO", "PINGILAP", "SAPWUAHFIK"), "POHNPEI", state),

    # YAP MAIN
    region = if_else(county %in% c("COLONIA", "DALIPEBINAW", "DALIPEEBINAEW", "FANIF", "GAGIL", "GILMAN", "KANIFAY", "MAAP", "RULL", "RUUL", "RUMUNG", "TOMIL", "TAMIL", "WELOY", "WEELOEY", "YAP PH"), "MAIN", region),
    
 state  = if_else(county %in% c("COLONIA", "DALIPEBINAW", "FANIF", "GAGIL", "GILMAN", "KANIFAY", "MAAP", "RULL", "RUMUNG", "TOMIL", "WELOY", "YAP PH"), "YAP", state),

    # YAP OUTER
    region = if_else(county %in% c("EAURIPIK","ELATO", "ELATO     
 ISLAND", "FAIS", "FARAULAP", "FECHAILAP", "IFALIK", "LAMOTREK", "NGULU", "SATAWAL", "ULITHI", "ULITHI ATOLL", "WOLEAI"), "OUTER", region),
    
  state  = if_else(county %in% c("EAURIPIK", "ELATO", "FAIS", "FARAULAP", "FECHAILAP", "IFALIK", "LAMOTREK","LAMOTREK ISLAND", "NGULU", "SATAWAL", "ULITHI", "WOLEAI"), "YAP", state),

    # Special Region overrides
    region = if_else(county == "MORTLOCK", "OUTER", region),
    region = if_else(county == "TATIW", "OUTER", region)
  ) %>%

  # --- HANDLE UNKNOWNS AND INFER STATE FROM PROVIDER ---
  mutate(
    # State/Region inferences for Unknown Counties
    state  = case_when(
      county == "UNKNOWN" & provider == "CHUUK STATE" ~ "CHUUK",
      county == "UNKNOWN" & provider == "KOSRAE STATE" ~ "KOSRAE",
      county == "UNKNOWN" & provider == "POHNPEI STATE" ~ "POHNPEI",
      county == "UNKNOWN" & provider == "YAP STATE" ~ "YAP",
      TRUE ~ state
    ),
    
    region = case_when(
      county == "UNKNOWN" & provider %in% c("CHUUK STATE", "KOSRAE STATE", "POHNPEI 
                                            STATE", "YAP STATE") ~ "UNKNOWN", 
      TRUE ~ region
    ),
    
    # Renaming County based on State for Unknowns
    county = case_when(
      county == "UNKNOWN" & state == "CHUUK" ~ "ZZ-UNKNOWN-CHUUK",
      county == "UNKNOWN" & state == "KOSRAE" ~ "ZZ-UNKNOWN-KOSRAE",
      county == "UNKNOWN" & state == "POHNPEI" ~ "ZZ-UNKNOWN-POHNPEI",
      county == "UNKNOWN" & state == "YAP" ~ "ZZ-UNKNOWN-YAP",
      TRUE ~ county
    ),

    # Final attempt to fill missing State from Provider
    state = case_when(
      is.na(state) & provider == "CHUUK STATE" ~ "CHUUK",
      is.na(state) & provider == "KOSRAE STATE" ~ "KOSRAE",
      is.na(state) & provider %in% c("POHNPEI FAMILY HEALTH CLINIC", "POHNPEI STATE") ~ "POHNPEI",
      is.na(state) & provider == "YAP STATE" ~ "YAP",
      TRUE ~ state
    )
  ) %>%

  # --- FINAL FILTERS ---
  filter(provider != "GUAM IMMUNIZATION REGISTRY")
```

# Merge HIB PRODUCT_DOSENUM & create vacine indicators

```{r vaccine indicators part 1, include=FALSE}
#this is creating the indicators, and making them numeric so they can later be counted
#this step must be done in a separate code chunk from counting doses and creating UTD variables. 

clean4 <- clean3 %>% 

#merge data frames by patient_id
left_join(product_dosenum, by = "patient_id") %>%  
  mutate(
    
#check after join to make sure no additional patients are added to the dataframe
    
    ################## BCG ##################
    
    bcg1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(bcg_date1), 1, 0)),
    
    ################## DTAP ##################
    
    dtap1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(dtap_date1), 1, 0)),
    dtap2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(dtap_date2), 1, 0)),
    dtap3 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(dtap_date3), 1, 0)),
    dtap4 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(dtap_date4), 1, 0)),
    dtap5 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(dtap_date5), 1, 0)),

    ################## IPV ##################
    
    ipv1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(ipv_date1), 1, 0)),
    ipv2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(ipv_date2), 1, 0)),
    ipv3 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(ipv_date3), 1, 0)),
    ipv4 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(ipv_date4), 1, 0)),

    ################## MMR ##################
    
    mmr1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(mmr_date1), 1, 0)),
    mmr2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(mmr_date2), 1, 0)),
    
    ################## HEPB ##################
    
    hepb1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hepb_date1), 1, 0)),
    hepb2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hepb_date2), 1, 0)),
    hepb3 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hepb_date3), 1, 0)),
    
    ################## PCV ##################
    
    pcv1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(pcv_date1), 1, 0)),
    pcv2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(pcv_date2), 1, 0)),
    pcv3 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(pcv_date3), 1, 0)),
    pcv4 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(pcv_date4), 1, 0)),
    
    ################## HIB ##################
    
    hib1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hib_date1), 1, 0)),
    hib2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hib_date2), 1, 0)),
    hib3 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hib_date3), 1, 0)),
    hib4 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(hib_date4), 1, 0)),
    
    ################## ROTA ##################
    
    rota1 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(rota_date1), 1, 0)),
    rota2 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(rota_date2), 1, 0)),
    rota3 = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(rota_date3), 1, 0)),

  ) #mutate close
```

# Count doses

```{r counting and creating doses, include=FALSE}
#counting doses and creating UTD variables 

clean5 <- clean4 %>% 
  mutate(
    
    ################## BCG BIRTHDOSE ##################
    #Counts a birth dose as given withing 3 days of birth
    
    bcg1days = as.numeric(difftime(bcg_date1, dob, unit = "days")),
    bcgbirthdose = ifelse(is.na(bcg_date1), 0, ifelse(bcg1days <=3, 1, 0)),
    
    ################## HEPB BIRTHDOSE ##################
    
    hepb1days = as.numeric(difftime(hepb_date1, dob, unit = "days")),
    hepbbirthdose = ifelse(is.na(hepb_date1), 0, ifelse(hepb1days <=3, 1, 0)),
    
    ################## DTAP ##################
    
    dtapcount = rowSums(select(., c(dtap1, dtap2, dtap3, dtap4, dtap5))),
    dtap1utd =ifelse(dtapcount >= 1, 1, 0),
    dtap2utd =ifelse(dtapcount >= 2, 1, 0),
    dtap3utd =ifelse(dtapcount >= 3, 1, 0),
    dtap4utd =ifelse(dtapcount >= 4, 1, 0),
    dtap5utd =ifelse(dtapcount >= 5, 1, 0),
    
    # -----------------------------
    # dtap 5/4 indicator
    # -----------------------------

    # age at dtap4
    dtap4days  = as.numeric(dtap_date4 - dob),
    dtap4years = floor(dtap4days / 365),

    dtap4yo = if_else(dtap4years >= 4, 1, 0),

    dtap54utd = if_else(
      dtap5utd == 1 | dtap4yo == 1,
      1, 0
    ),
    
  dtap_utd = case_when(
  age_months < 2 ~ NA_real_,
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 3 & dtap1utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 4 & age_months <= 5 & dtap2utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 11 & dtap3utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 47 & dtap4utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 48 & age_months <= 83 & dtap54utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 83 ~ 0,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ),
    
    ################## IPV ##################
    
    ipvcount = rowSums(select(., c(ipv1, ipv2, ipv3, ipv4))),
    ipv1utd =ifelse(ipvcount >= 1, 1, 0),
    ipv2utd =ifelse(ipvcount >= 2, 1, 0),
    ipv3utd =ifelse(ipvcount >= 3, 1, 0),
    ipv4utd =ifelse(ipvcount >= 4, 1, 0),
    
      # -----------------------------
    # polio 4/3 indicator
    # -----------------------------

    # age at ipv3
    ipv3days  = as.numeric(ipv_date3 - dob),
    ipv3years = floor(ipv3days / 365),

    ipv4yo = if_else(ipv3years >= 4, 1, 0),

    ipv43utd = if_else(
      ipv4utd == 1 | ipv4yo == 1,
      1, 0 ),
    
  ipv_utd = case_when(
  age_months < 2 ~ NA_real_,
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 3 & ipv1utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 4 & age_months <= 5 & ipv2utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 47 & ipv3utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 48 & age_months <= 83 & ipv43utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 83 ~ 0,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ),
    ################## MMR ##################
    
    mmrcount = rowSums(select(., c(mmr1, mmr2))),
    mmr1utd =ifelse(mmrcount >= 1, 1, 0),
    mmr2utd =ifelse(mmrcount >= 2, 1, 0),
    
   mmr_utd = case_when(
  age_months < 12 ~ NA_real_,
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 47 & mmr1utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 48 & age_months <= 83 & mmr2utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 ~ 0,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ),
    ################## HEPB ##################
    
    hepbcount = rowSums(select(., c(hepb1, hepb2, hepb3))),
    hepb1utd =ifelse(hepbcount >= 1, 1, 0),
    hepb2utd =ifelse(hepbcount >= 2, 1, 0),
    hepb3utd =ifelse(hepbcount >= 3, 1, 0),
    
  hepb_utd = case_when(
  age_months >= 0 & age_months <= 3 & hepb1utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 4 & age_months <= 4 & hepb2utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 83 & hepb3utd == 1 ~ 1,
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 83 ~ 0,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ),
  
    ################## PCV ##################
    
    pcvcount = rowSums(select(., c(pcv1, pcv2, pcv3, pcv4))),
    pcv1utd =ifelse(pcvcount >= 1, 1, 0),
    pcv2utd =ifelse(pcvcount >= 2, 1, 0),
    pcv3utd =ifelse(pcvcount >= 3, 1, 0),
    pcv4utd =ifelse(pcvcount >= 4, 1, 0),
    
    ################## ROTA ##################
    
    rotacount = rowSums(select(., c(rota1, rota2, rota3))),
    rota1utd =ifelse(rotacount >= 1, 1, 0),
    rota2utd =ifelse(rotacount >= 2, 1, 0),
    rota3utd =ifelse(rotacount >= 3, 1, 0),
    
    ################## HIB ##################
    
    hibcount = rowSums(select(., c(hib1, hib2, hib3, hib4))),
    hib1utd =ifelse(hibcount >= 1, 1, 0),
    hib2utd =ifelse(hibcount >= 2, 1, 0),
    hib3utd =ifelse(hibcount >= 3, 1, 0),
    hib4utd =ifelse(hibcount >= 4, 1, 0),
    
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
#!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

         ################## HIB UTD ##################

#!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
#If patient received ahpvuo primary series or mix of first two doses, need 4 doses: 2, 4, 6, and 15-18 months

#if the second or third dose is after 12 months, don't need the 4th dose

#if patient received pedvaxhib primary series, need 3 doses: 2, 4, and 12-15 months

####################### product_dosenum is needed here (merged in earlier code)  #######################

#if mix of products:
#if first two doses are pedvaxhib, only need 3rd dose at 12 – 15 months
#if first two are a 3-dose primary series product or one pedvaxhib + 1 other, then need 3rd dose at 6 months and 4th dose at 12 – 15 months;

  
    any_ahpvuo = ifelse(product_1 == "ahpvuo" | 
                        product_2 == "ahpvuo" | 
                        product_3 == "ahpvuo" | 
                        product_4 == "ahpvuo", 1, 0),
    
    any_pedvaxhib = ifelse(product_1 == "pedvaxhib" | 
                           product_2 == "pedvaxhib" | 
                           product_3 == "pedvaxhib" | 
                           product_4 == "pedvaxhib", 1, 0),
    
    primary_ahpvuo = ifelse(product_1 == "ahpvuo" & 
                             product_2 == "ahpvuo", 1, 0),
    
    primary_pedvaxhib = ifelse(product_1 == "pedvaxhib" & 
                                product_2 == "pedvaxhib", 1, 0),
    
    primary_mix = ifelse((product_1 == "ahpvuo" & product_2 == "pedvaxhib") | 
                         (product_1 == "pedvaxhib" & product_2 == "ahpvuo"), 1, 0),
    
#calculate age at each dose
    #age in days
    hib1days = as.numeric(difftime(hib_date1, dob, unit = "days")),
    hib2days = as.numeric(difftime(hib_date2, dob, unit = "days")),
    hib3days = as.numeric(difftime(hib_date3, dob, unit = "days")),
    hib4days = as.numeric(difftime(hib_date4, dob, unit = "days")),
    #age in months
    hib1mos = floor(hib1days / 30.41667),
    hib2mos = floor(hib2days / 30.41667),
    hib3mos = floor(hib3days / 30.41667),
    hib4mos = floor(hib4days / 30.41667),
    #interval between doses
    hibint12 = as.numeric(interval(hib_date1, hib_date2) / dweeks(1)),
    hibint23 = as.numeric(interval(hib_date2, hib_date3) / dweeks(1)),
    hibint34 = as.numeric(interval(hib_date3, hib_date4) / dweeks(1)),
    hibint24 = as.numeric(interval(hib_date2, hib_date4) / dweeks(1)),
    
#create hibutd
hib_utd = case_when(

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ages 2–3 months: UTD with at least 1 valid Hib dose
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 3 &
    hib1utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ages 4–5 months: UTD with at least 2 valid Hib doses
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  age_months >= 4 & age_months <= 5 &
    hib2utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ages 6–11 months
  # AHPVUO or mixed primary series: 3 valid doses
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 11 &
    (primary_ahpvuo == 1 | primary_mix == 1) &
    hib3utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # PedvaxHIB primary series: 2 valid doses
  age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 11 &
    primary_pedvaxhib == 1 &
    hib2utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ages 12–18 months
  # AHPVUO or mixed primary series: 4 valid doses
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 18 &
    (primary_ahpvuo == 1 | primary_mix == 1) &
    hib4utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # PedvaxHIB primary series:
  # 3 valid doses, with dose 3 given at age 12 months or older
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 18 &
    primary_pedvaxhib == 1 &
    hib3utd == 1 &
    hib3mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # PedvaxHIB primary series:
  # alternatively, UTD if a fourth valid dose was received
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 18 &
    primary_pedvaxhib == 1 &
    hib4utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ages 19–83 months: three-dose product primary series
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  age_months >= 19 & age_months <= 83 &
    primary_ahpvuo == 1 &
    hib1utd == 1 & hib1mos < 12 &
    hib2utd == 1 & hib2mos < 12 &
    hib3utd == 1 & hib3mos < 12 &
    hib4utd == 1 & hib4mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # Two-dose PedvaxHIB primary series
  age_months >= 19 & age_months <= 83 &
    primary_pedvaxhib == 1 &
    hib1utd == 1 & hib1mos < 12 &
    hib2utd == 1 & hib2mos < 12 &
    hib3utd == 1 & hib3mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # Mixed primary series
  age_months >= 19 & age_months <= 83 &
    primary_mix == 1 &
    hib1utd == 1 & hib1mos < 12 &
    hib2utd == 1 & hib2mos < 12 &
    hib3utd == 1 & hib3mos < 12 &
    hib4utd == 1 & hib4mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Catch-up rules for ages 12–83 months
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # Dose 1 at 7–11 months, dose 2 at least 4 weeks later,
  # and dose 3 at age 12 months or older and at least
  # 8 weeks after dose 2
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 59 &
    hib1utd == 1 &
    hib1mos >= 7 & hib1mos < 12 &
    hib2utd == 1 &
    hibint12 >= 4 &
    hib3utd == 1 &
    hib3mos >= 12 &
    hibint23 >= 8 ~ 1,

  # Dose 1 at 12–14 months and dose 2 at least 8 weeks later
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 59 &
    hib1utd == 1 &
    hib1mos >= 12 & hib1mos < 15 &
    hib2utd == 1 &
    hibint12 >= 8 ~ 1,

  # Dose 1 before 12 months, dose 2 before 15 months,
  # and dose 3 at least 8 weeks after dose 2
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    hib1utd == 1 &
    hib1mos < 12 &
    hib2utd == 1 &
    hib2mos < 15 &
    hib3utd == 1 &
    hibint23 >= 8 ~ 1,

  # One valid dose at age 15 months or older
  age_months >= 15 & age_months <= 83 &
    hib1utd == 1 &
    hib1mos >= 15 ~ 1,

  # Allow UTD with 3 valid doses of any product when
  # dose 3 was administered at age 12 months or older
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    hib3utd == 1 &
    hib3mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # Children aged 2–83 months who do not meet an applicable rule
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 83 ~ 0,

  # Outside the assessed age range
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
),
    

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
#!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

         ################## PCV UTD ##################

#!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    #age at each dose
    #days
    pcv1days = as.numeric(difftime(pcv_date1, dob, unit = "days")),
    pcv2days = as.numeric(difftime(pcv_date2, dob, unit = "days")),
    pcv3days = as.numeric(difftime(pcv_date3, dob, unit = "days")),
    pcv4days = as.numeric(difftime(pcv_date4, dob, unit = "days")),
    #months
    pcv1mos = floor(pcv1days / 30.41667),
    pcv2mos = floor(pcv2days / 30.41667),
    pcv3mos = floor(pcv3days / 30.41667),
    pcv4mos = floor(pcv4days / 30.41667),
    
#create pcvutd
    pcv_utd = case_when(

  # Routine age-specific schedule
  age_months < 2 ~ NA_real_,

  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 3 &
    pcv1utd == 1 ~ 1,

  age_months >= 4 & age_months <= 5 &
    pcv2utd == 1 ~ 1,

  age_months >= 6 & age_months <= 11 &
    pcv3utd == 1 ~ 1,

  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv4utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # Catch-up: 3 doses before 12 months and dose 4 after 12 months
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv1utd == 1 & pcv1mos < 12 &
    pcv2utd == 1 & pcv2mos < 12 &
    pcv3utd == 1 & pcv3mos < 12 &
    pcv4utd == 1 & pcv4mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # Doses 1 and 2 before 12 months and dose 3 after 12 months
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv1utd == 1 & pcv1mos < 12 &
    pcv2utd == 1 & pcv2mos < 12 &
    pcv3utd == 1 & pcv3mos >= 12 ~ 1,

  # Dose 1 before 12 months, dose 2 at 12–23 months,
  # and dose 3 received
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv1utd == 1 & pcv1mos < 12 &
    pcv2utd == 1 & pcv2mos >= 12 & pcv2mos < 24 &
    pcv3utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # Dose 1 before 12 months and dose 2 at 24 months or older
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv1utd == 1 & pcv1mos < 12 &
    pcv2utd == 1 & pcv2mos >= 24 ~ 1,

  # Dose 1 at 12–23 months and dose 2 received
  age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv1utd == 1 &
    pcv1mos >= 12 & pcv1mos < 24 &
    pcv2utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # First dose at 24 months or older
  age_months >= 24 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv1utd == 1 &
    pcv1mos >= 24 ~ 1,

  # Any child with four valid doses
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 83 &
    pcv4utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # Not UTD within assessed age range
  age_months >= 2 & age_months <= 83 ~ 0,

  TRUE ~ NA_real_
),

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  # ROTA UTD: Ignore FSM ONLY USES 3 DOSE PRODUCT 

#!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
  #CREATE FSM-SPECIFIC MMR RECOMMENDATION - this is for field master list only, not for risk score

  mmr_date1 = as.Date(mmr_date1),
  days_since_mmr1 = as.numeric(Sys.Date() - mmr_date1),

  need_mmr = str_detect(
    immunization_recommendations,
    regex("MMR/MEASLES\\s*\\(", ignore_case = TRUE)
  ) |
    (
      age_months >= 12 & age_months <= 47 &   # age 1-3 years
      mmr1utd == 1 &                          # received dose 1
      mmr2utd == 0 &                          # has not received dose 2
      days_since_mmr1 > 30                    # more than 30 days since dose 1
    ),

  MMR_Single = if_else(need_mmr, 1, 0)
)
#mutate close
```

# Create vaccine series indicators, UTD for age, time since last vax, age at last vax

```{r series indicators, include=FALSE}
#creating utd series variables 

clean6 <- clean5 %>% 
  mutate(

#SERIES 4:3:2:3:3:4
#≥4 DTaP, ≥3 IPV, ≥2 MMR, ≥3 Hib, ≥3 HepB, and ≥4 PCV.
   series432334= ifelse(dtap4utd==1 & ipv3utd==1 & mmr2utd==1 & hib3utd==1 & hepb3utd==1 & pcv4utd==1, 1, 0),
   
#SERIES 4:3:2:Hib UTD:3:PCV UTD 
#≥4 DTaP, ≥3 IPV, ≥2 MMR, Hib UTD, ≥3 HepB, and PCV UTD. 
  series432hibutd3pcvutd= ifelse(dtap4utd==1 & ipv3utd==1 & mmr2utd==1 & hib_utd==1 & hepb3utd==1 & pcv_utd==1, 1, 0),
    
#SERIES 4:3:1:3:3:4
#≥4 DTaP, ≥3 IPV, ≥1 MMR, ≥3 Hib, ≥3 HepB, and ≥4 PCV.
  series431334= ifelse(dtap4utd==1 & ipv3utd==1 & mmr1utd==1 & hib3utd==1 & hepb3utd==1  & pcv4utd==1, 1, 0), 

#SERIES 4:3:1:Hib UTD:3:PCV UTD 
#≥4 DTaP, ≥3 IPV, ≥1 MMR, Hib UTD, ≥3 HepB, and PCV UTD. 
  series431hibutd3pcvutd= ifelse(dtap4utd==1 & ipv3utd==1 & mmr1utd==1 & hib_utd==1 & hepb3utd==1 & pcv_utd==1, 1, 0),
    

#UTD for age (includes MMR)
utd = case_when(
  # 2–3 months: 1 dtap, 1 ipv, 1 hib, 2 hepb, 1 pcv
  agegroup == 1 &
    dtap1utd == 1 & ipv1utd == 1 & hib1utd == 1 & hepb2utd == 1 & pcv1utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 4–5 months: 2 dtap, 2 ipv, 2 hib, 2 hepb, 2 pcv
  agegroup == 2 &
    dtap2utd == 1 & ipv2utd == 1 & hib2utd == 1 & hepb2utd == 1 & pcv2utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 6–11 months: 3 dtap, 3 ipv, 2 hib, 3 hepb, 3 pcv
  agegroup == 3 &
    dtap3utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & hib2utd == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv3utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 12–18 months: 4 dtap, 3 ipv, 1 mmr, 3 hib, 3 hepb, 4 pcv
  agegroup == 4 &
    dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr1utd == 1 &
    hib3utd == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv4utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 19–35 months - changed MMR to 1 for purpose of risk assessment
  agegroup == 5 &
    dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr1utd == 1 &
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,

  # 36–47 months - changed MMR to 1 for purpose of risk assessment
  agegroup == 6 &
    dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr1utd == 1 &
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,

  # 48–59 months
  agegroup == 7 &
    dtap54utd == 1 & ipv43utd == 1 & mmr2utd == 1 &
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,
  
    # 60–71 months
  agegroup == 8 &
    dtap54utd == 1 & ipv43utd == 1 & mmr2utd == 1 &
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,
  
    # 72–83 months
  agegroup == 9 &
    dtap54utd == 1 & ipv43utd == 1 & mmr2utd == 1 &
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,

  TRUE ~ 0
),


#UTD for age - NO MMR included
utd_no_mmr = case_when(
  # 2–3 months: 1 dtap, 1 ipv, 1 hib, 2 hepb, 1 pcv
  agegroup == 1 &
    dtap1utd == 1 & ipv1utd == 1 & hib1utd == 1 & hepb2utd == 1 & pcv1utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 4–5 months: 2 dtap, 2 ipv, 2 hib, 2 hepb, 2 pcv
  agegroup == 2 &
    dtap2utd == 1 & ipv2utd == 1 & hib2utd == 1 & hepb2utd == 1 & pcv2utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 6–11 months: 3 dtap, 3 ipv, 2 hib, 3 hepb, 3 pcv
  agegroup == 3 &
    dtap3utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & hib2utd == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv3utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 12–18 months: 4 dtap, 3 ipv, 3 hib, 3 hepb, 4 pcv --- NO MMR
  agegroup == 4 &
    dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & hib3utd == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv4utd == 1 ~ 1,

  # 19–35 months --- NO MMR
  agegroup == 5 &
    dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & 
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,

  # 36–47 months --- NO MMR
  agegroup == 6 &
    dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & 
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,

  # 48–59 months --- NO MMR
  agegroup == 7 &
    dtap54utd == 1 & ipv43utd == 1 & 
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,
  
   # 60-71 months --- NO MMR
  agegroup == 8 &
    dtap54utd == 1 & ipv43utd == 1 & 
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,
  
   # 72-83 months --- NO MMR
  agegroup == 9 &
    dtap54utd == 1 & ipv43utd == 1 & 
    (hib3utd == 1 | hib_utd == 1) &
    hepb3utd == 1 &
    (pcv4utd == 1 | pcv_utd == 1) ~ 1,

  TRUE ~ 0
),


  #time since last vax
 years_since_last_vax = time_length(
      interval(last_vaccination_date, Sys.Date()),
      unit = "years"
    ),

 days_since_last_vax = time_length(
      interval(last_vaccination_date, Sys.Date()),
      unit = "days"
    ),

dob = as.Date(dob),
last_vaccination_date = as.Date(last_vaccination_date),

#age at last vax
 age_last_vax = time_length(
      interval(dob, last_vaccination_date),
      unit = "months"
    ),

   last_vax_category = case_when(
      years_since_last_vax < 1                       ~ "< 1 year",
      years_since_last_vax >= 1 & years_since_last_vax < 2 ~ "1–2 years",
      years_since_last_vax >= 2 & years_since_last_vax < 5 ~ "2–4 years",
      years_since_last_vax >= 5                       ~ "≥ 5 years",
      TRUE                                            ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

   #mutate close
```

```{r clean7, include=FALSE}
clean7 <- clean6 %>%
  select(
    provider,
    clinic,

    primary_contact_lastname_firstname,
    gender,
    dob,

    state,
    zip,
    last_vaccination_date,
    years_since_last_vax,

    bcg_date1,
    
    dtap_date1, dtap_date2, dtap_date3, dtap_date4, dtap_date5, dtap_date6,
```

# Merge Full Dataset with PlaceNames dataset for lat/long coordinates by village

# Next, check for any of the duplicate placenames and any additional cleaning

## Iterative process to ensure as many children as possible are linked to GIS

clean11_merged is the final patient-level dataframe from this step

```{r village mapping, include=FALSE}

# Filter to wanted feature classes
placenames2 <- placenames %>%
  filter(feature_class %in% c("Island", "Civil", "Populated Place")) %>%
  
  # Keep only needed variables
  select(feature_class, feature_name, pn_excel_index, latitude, longitude)%>%
  
  # optional but strongly recommended for exact matching cleanup
  mutate(
    feature_name = str_to_upper(trimws(as.character(feature_name)))
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove exact duplicate rows where name + lat + lon are the same
  distinct(feature_name, latitude, longitude, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Check which feature_names are still duplicated because they refer to different places
placename_dupes <- placenames2 %>%
  add_count(feature_name, name = "n_name_matches") %>%
  filter(n_name_matches > 1) %>%
  arrange(feature_name)

# Keep only feature_names that occur once in placenames
placenames_unique <- placenames2 %>%
  add_count(feature_name, name = "n_name_matches") %>%
  filter(n_name_matches == 1) %>%
  select(-n_name_matches)

# Optional: standardize city in clean7 for exact matching
clean7 <- clean7 %>%
  mutate(city = trimws(as.character(city)))

# Merge safely into clean7
# This will NOT create new rows because left_join keeps all rows from clean7
clean7_merged <- clean7 %>%
  left_join(
    placenames_unique,
    by = c("city" = "feature_name")
  )

#Next round, where not matched look at county

placenames_county <- placenames_unique %>%
  mutate(feature_name_join = str_trim(str_to_upper(feature_name))) %>%
  rename(
    county_lat = latitude,
    county_lon = longitude,
    county_class = feature_class,
    county_index = pn_excel_index
  ) %>%
  select(feature_name_join, county_lat, county_lon, county_class, county_index)

clean8_merged <- clean7_merged %>%
  mutate(county_join = str_trim(str_to_upper(county))) %>%
  left_join(
    placenames_county,
    by = c("county_join" = "feature_name_join")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    latitude   = if_else(is.na(latitude), county_lat, latitude),
    longitude  = if_else(is.na(longitude), county_lon, longitude),
    feature_class = if_else(is.na(feature_class), county_class, feature_class),
    PN_Excel_Index = if_else(is.na(pn_excel_index), county_index, pn_excel_index)
  ) %>%
  select(-county_join, -county_lat, -county_lon, -county_class, -county_index)

#Next round, look at rr_county

placenames_rr <- placenames_unique %>%
  mutate(feature_name_join = str_trim(str_to_upper(feature_name))) %>%
  rename(
    rr_lat = latitude,
    rr_lon = longitude,
    rr_class = feature_class,
    rr_index = pn_excel_index
  ) %>%
  select(feature_name_join, rr_lat, rr_lon, rr_class, rr_index)

clean9_merged <- clean8_merged %>%
  mutate(rr_county_join = str_trim(str_to_upper(rr_county))) %>%
  left_join(
    placenames_rr,
    by = c("rr_county_join" = "feature_name_join")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    latitude   = if_else(is.na(latitude), rr_lat, latitude),
    longitude  = if_else(is.na(longitude), rr_lon, longitude),
    feature_class = if_else(is.na(feature_class), rr_class, feature_class),
    pn_excel_index = if_else(is.na(pn_excel_index), rr_index, pn_excel_index)
  ) %>%
  select(-rr_county_join, -rr_lat, -rr_lon, -rr_class, -rr_index)

#Final - manual input
```

# Create individual risk score

```{r risk score, include=FALSE}

clean12_merged <- clean11_merged %>%
  mutate(
    months_since_last_vax = days_since_last_vax / 30.4375,
    
    t_i = pmin(months_since_last_vax, 36, na.rm = TRUE),

    #scale from 1 to 0
    t_i_tilde = t_i / 36,

    individual_risk_score = 100 * (
      0.20 * if_else(utd_no_mmr == 1, 1, 0, missing = 0) +
      0.55 * if_else(mmr_utd == 0, 1, 0, missing = 0) +
      0.25 * t_i_tilde
    )
  )
```

and county - UTD for age by county table - using the standard UTD
including MMR

by county

# Table 1 - This creates a table of the number of children not up to date for age (Targets) by county and BY vaccine type (e.g., DTaP, IPV)

# !! Update filename date for each new run !!

```{r targets, include=FALSE}

# 1. Summarize by county
base_table <- clean13_merged %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(onreminder, na.rm = TRUE),
    DTaP = sum(need_dtap, na.rm = TRUE),
    IPV  = sum(need_ipv,  na.rm = TRUE),
    MMR  = sum(need_mmr,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Hib  = sum(need_hib,  na.rm = TRUE),
    HepB = sum(need_hepb, na.rm = TRUE),
    PCV  = sum(need_pcv,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Rotavirus = sum(need_rota, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

# 2. Add total row
fsm_total <- clean13_merged %>%
  summarise(
    county = "FSM Total",
    Total= sum(onreminder, na.rm = TRUE),
    DTaP = sum(need_dtap, na.rm = TRUE),
    IPV  = sum(need_ipv,  na.rm = TRUE),
    MMR  = sum(need_mmr,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Hib  = sum(need_hib,  na.rm = TRUE),
    HepB = sum(need_hepb, na.rm = TRUE),
    PCV  = sum(need_pcv,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Rotavirus = sum(need_rota, na.rm = TRUE)

combined <- bind_rows(fsm_total, base_table)
```

```{r}
make_block <- function(data, county_name) {
  sub <- data %>% filter(county == county_name)
  
  bind_rows(
    sub %>%
      summarise(
        row_label = paste0(county_name, " Total"),
        Denominator = n(),
        `% UTD for age` = round((sum(utd_num, na.rm = TRUE) / n()) * 100, 1)
      ),
    
    sub %>%
      group_by(age_group) %>%
      summarise(
        Denominator = n(),
        utd_n = sum(utd_num, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_order)) %>%
      arrange(age_group) %>%
      mutate(
        row_label = paste0("   ", as.character(age_group)),
        `% UTD for age` = round((utd_n / Denominator) * 100, 1)
      ) %>%
      select(row_label, Denominator, `% UTD for age`)
  )
}

fsm_block <- bind_rows(
  utd_table %>%
    summarise(
      row_label = "FSM Total",
      Denominator = n(),
      `% UTD for age` = round((sum(utd_num, na.rm = TRUE) / n()) * 100, 1)
    ),
  utd_table %>%
    group_by(age_group) %>%
    summarise(
      Denominator = n(),
      utd_n = sum(utd_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_order)) %>%
    arrange(age_group) %>%
    mutate(
      row_label = paste0("   ", as.character(age_group)),
      `% UTD for age` = round((utd_n / Denominator) * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    select(row_label, Denominator, `% UTD for age`)
)

final_table <- bind_rows(
  fsm_block,
  bind_rows(lapply(county_order, \(x) make_block(utd_table, x)))
)

write_xlsx(final_table, "Output/Table 3_FSM_County_UTD_061926.xlsx")
```

# Tables 5a and 5b - FSM 19–35 month coverage and series tables formatted like FSM Table Templates.xlsx

```{r fsm_19_35_coverage_and_series_export, include=FALSE}
#========================================================
# Export 19–35 month FSM coverage and series tables
# formatted like "FSM Table Templates.xlsx"
#========================================================

if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)


# Region lookup used as a fallback if region is missing/blank.
chuuk_main <- c("WENO", "IRAS", "MWAN", "NEPUKOS", "PENIESENE", "WICHAP")
chuuk_lagoon <- c("ETTEN", "EOT", "EOT ISLAND", "FANAPANGES", "FEFAN", "FONOTON",
                  "FONO", "PAREM-CHUUK", "PAREM", "PPO-ONEI", "ONEI",
                  "WONEI", "ONOUN", "PAATA", "PATA", "PATTA", "PPO-PATTA", "PPO-POLLE", "POLLE",
                  "ROMALUM", "ROMONUM", "SAPOTA", "SAPOTIW", "SIIS", "TOLENSOM",
                  "TONOAS", "UDOT", "UMAN")

chuuk_outer <- c("ETTAL", "ETAL", "FANANU", "HOUK", "KUTTU", "LEKINIOCH",   "LOSAP", "LOSAP ATOLL",  
                 "LUKUNOR ATOLL", "MAKUR", "MOCH", "MORTLOCK", "MORTLOCKS", "MURILO", "MURILO ATOLL","NAMA","NAMOLUK", "NAMONUITO ATOLL", "NEAUO", "NOMWIN", "NOMWIN ATOLL","NORTHWEST", "ONEOP", "ONO", 
                   "ONOUN", "PIHARAR", "PISEMWAR", "PIISEMWAR", "POLLAP", "PULAP", "PULAP ATOLL",
                    "POLOWAT", "PULUWAT", "RUO", "SATAWAN", "SATAWAN ATOLL","TA", "TAMATAM", "CHK_MORT", 
                     "UNANU", "ONOU", "CHK_O")
yap_main <- c("COLONIA", "DALIPEBINAW", "DALIPEEBINAEW", "FANIF", "GAGIL", "GILMAN",
              "KANIFAY", "MAAP", "RULL", "RUUL", "RUMUNG", "TOMIL", "TAMIL",
              "WELOY", "WEELOEY", "YAP PH")
yap_outer <- c("EAURIPIK", "ELATO", "ELATO ISLAND", "FAIS", "FARAULAP", "FECHAILAP",
               "IFALIK", "LAMOTREK", "LAMOTREK ISLAND", "NGULU", "SATAWAL", "SATAWAL ATOLL", "ULITHI",
               "ULITHI ATOLL", "WOLEAI")

fsm_19_35 <- clean13_merged %>%
  mutate(
    state_clean  = str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(state.x))),
    county_clean = str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(county))),
    region_clean = if ("region" %in% names(.)) str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(region))) else NA_character_,
    state_clean = case_when(
      state_clean %in% c("CH", "CHUUK") ~ "CHUUK",
      state_clean %in% c("KO", "KOSRAE") ~ "KOSRAE",
      state_clean %in% c("PO", "POHNPEI") ~ "POHNPEI",
      state_clean %in% c("YA", "YAP") ~ "YAP",
      TRUE ~ state_clean
    ),
    region_clean = case_when(
      is.na(region_clean) | region_clean == "" | region_clean == "NA" ~ case_when(
        state_clean == "CHUUK" & county_clean %in% chuuk_main   ~ "MAIN",
        state_clean == "CHUUK" & county_clean %in% chuuk_lagoon ~ "LAGOON",
        state_clean == "CHUUK" & county_clean %in% chuuk_outer  ~ "OUTER",
        state_clean == "YAP"   & county_clean %in% yap_main     ~ "MAIN",
        state_clean == "YAP"   & county_clean %in% yap_outer    ~ "OUTER",
        TRUE ~ region_clean
      ),
      TRUE ~ region_clean
    ),
    hepb_birth_dose = if_else(!is.na(hepb_date1) & as.numeric(difftime(as.Date(hepb_date1), as.Date(dob), units = "days")) <= 3, 1, 0, missing = 0),
    
    bcg_birth_dose  = if_else(!is.na(bcg_date1)  & as.numeric(difftime(as.Date(bcg_date1),  as.Date(dob), units = "days")) <= 3, 1, 0, missing = 0),
    
    hib_primary_series = case_when(
      primary_pedvaxhib == 1 ~ as.integer(hib2utd == 1),
      TRUE ~ as.integer(hib3utd == 1)
    ),
    hib_full_series = case_when(
      primary_pedvaxhib == 1 ~ as.integer(hib3utd == 1),
      TRUE ~ as.integer(hib4utd == 1)
    ),
    
    series432_hibfull_334 = as.integer(dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr2utd == 1 & hib_full_series == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv4utd == 1),
    series431_hibfull_334 = as.integer(dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr1utd == 1 & hib_full_series == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv4utd == 1),
    series432_hibfull_3_pcvutd = as.integer(dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr2utd == 1 & hib_full_series == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv_utd == 1),
    series431_hibfull_3_pcvutd = as.integer(dtap4utd == 1 & ipv3utd == 1 & mmr1utd == 1 & hib_full_series == 1 & hepb3utd == 1 & pcv_utd == 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(age_months >= 19, age_months <= 35)

# Column groups in the exact order used by the template workbook.
group_names <- c(
  "FSM", "Chuuk", "Chuuk main island", "Chuuk lagoon island", "Chuuk outer islands",
  "Kosrae", "Pohnpei", "Yap", "Yap main island", "Yap outer islands"
)

filter_group <- function(data, group_name) {
  switch(
    group_name,
    "FSM"                 = data,
    "Chuuk"               = data %>% filter(state_clean == "CHUUK"),
    "Chuuk main island"   = data %>% filter(state_clean == "CHUUK", region_clean == "MAIN"),
    "Chuuk lagoon island" = data %>% filter(state_clean == "CHUUK", region_clean == "LAGOON"),
    "Chuuk outer islands" = data %>% filter(state_clean == "CHUUK", region_clean == "OUTER"),
    "Kosrae"              = data %>% filter(state_clean == "KOSRAE"),
    "Pohnpei"             = data %>% filter(state_clean == "POHNPEI"),
    "Yap"                 = data %>% filter(state_clean == "YAP"),
    "Yap main island"     = data %>% filter(state_clean == "YAP", region_clean == "MAIN"),
    "Yap outer islands"   = data %>% filter(state_clean == "YAP", region_clean == "OUTER")
  )
}

fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

make_display_table <- function(data, row_specs) {
  out <- vector("list", nrow(row_specs))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(row_specs))) {
    this_label <- row_specs$label[i]
    this_var   <- row_specs$var[i]

    row <- list(label = this_label)

    for (g in group_names) {
      gdata <- filter_group(data, g)
      n_col <- paste0(g, "_n")
      p_col <- paste0(g, "_pct")

      if (is.na(this_var)) {
        row[[n_col]] <- NA_real_
        row[[p_col]] <- NA_real_
      } else {
        denom <- nrow(gdata)
        num <- if (denom == 0) NA_real_ else sum(gdata[[this_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        pct <- if (denom == 0) NA_real_ else round((num / denom) * 100, 1)
        row[[n_col]] <- num
        row[[p_col]] <- pct
      }
    }

    out[[i]] <- as_tibble(row)
  }

  bind_rows(out)
}

#========================================================
# Excel formatting helper
#========================================================
write_template_style_table <- function(wb, sheet, title, display_table, row_specs, footnotes) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet, gridLines = TRUE)

  n_groups <- length(group_names)
  n_cols <- 1 + (n_groups * 2)
  last_col <- int2col(n_cols)
  data_start <- 4
  data_end <- data_start + nrow(display_table) - 1
  foot_start <- data_end + 1

  title_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 10, halign = "left", valign = "bottom",
                             border = "bottom", borderStyle = "thin")
  group_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 10, halign = "center", valign = "center",
                             wrapText = TRUE, border = "top", borderStyle = "thin")
  subhead_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, halign = "center", valign = "center",
                               border = "bottom", borderStyle = "thin")
  label_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, halign = "left")
  n_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, halign = "center", numFmt = "#,##0")
  pct_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, halign = "center", numFmt = "0.0")
  section_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 10, halign = "left")
  bottom_border_style <- createStyle(border = "bottom", borderStyle = "thin")
  vline_style <- createStyle(border = "left", borderStyle = "thin")
  footnote_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 8, halign = "left", valign = "top", wrapText = TRUE)

  # Title row
  writeData(wb, sheet, title, startRow = 1, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  mergeCells(wb, sheet, cols = 1:n_cols, rows = 1)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)

  # Group headers and n/% subheaders
  writeData(wb, sheet, "", startRow = 2, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet, "", startRow = 3, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_along(group_headers)) {
    start_col <- 2 + ((i - 1) * 2)
    writeData(wb, sheet, group_headers[i], startRow = 2, startCol = start_col, colNames = FALSE)
    mergeCells(wb, sheet, cols = start_col:(start_col + 1), rows = 2)
    writeData(wb, sheet, c("n", "%"), startRow = 3, startCol = start_col, colNames = FALSE)
  }
  addStyle(wb, sheet, group_style, rows = 2, cols = 2:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, subhead_style, rows = 3, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)

  # Body
  writeData(wb, sheet, display_table, startRow = data_start, startCol = 1,
            colNames = FALSE, keepNA = FALSE)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, label_style, rows = data_start:data_end, cols = 1, gridExpand = TRUE)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, n_style, rows = data_start:data_end, cols = seq(2, n_cols, by = 2), gridExpand = TRUE)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, pct_style, rows = data_start:data_end, cols = seq(3, n_cols, by = 2), gridExpand = TRUE)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, bottom_border_style, rows = data_end, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # Section rows for the series table
  section_rows <- which(is.na(row_specs$var)) + data_start - 1
  if (length(section_rows) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet, section_style, rows = section_rows, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  }

  # Vertical lines between jurisdiction groups, matching the template look.
  for (col in seq(4, n_cols, by = 2)) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet, vline_style, rows = 2:data_end, cols = col, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  }

  # Footnotes
  for (i in seq_along(footnotes)) {
    r <- foot_start + i - 1
    writeData(wb, sheet, footnotes[i], startRow = r, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
    mergeCells(wb, sheet, cols = 1:n_cols, rows = r)
    addStyle(wb, sheet, footnote_style, rows = r, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 1, widths = 34)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 2:n_cols, widths = 9)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = 2, heights = 38)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = foot_start:(foot_start + length(footnotes) - 1), heights = 28)
  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstActiveRow = 4, firstActiveCol = 2)
}
```

```{r}
chuuk_audit <- clean13_merged %>%
  mutate(
    state_raw  = as.character(state.x),
    county_raw = as.character(county),
    region_raw = if ("region" %in% names(.)) as.character(region) else NA_character_,

    state_clean = str_to_upper(str_squish(state_raw)),
    county_clean = str_to_upper(str_squish(county_raw)),
    region_original_clean = str_to_upper(str_squish(region_raw)),

    state_clean = case_when(
      state_clean %in% c("CH", "CHUUK") ~ "CHUUK",
      state_clean %in% c("KO", "KOSRAE") ~ "KOSRAE",
      state_clean %in% c("PO", "POHNPEI") ~ "POHNPEI",
      state_clean %in% c("YA", "YAP") ~ "YAP",
      TRUE ~ state_clean
    ),

    # Reproduce the current region logic exactly
    region_current = case_when(
      is.na(region_original_clean) |
        region_original_clean == "" |
        region_original_clean == "NA" ~ case_when(
          state_clean == "CHUUK" & county_clean %in% chuuk_main   ~ "MAIN",
          state_clean == "CHUUK" & county_clean %in% chuuk_lagoon ~ "LAGOON",
          state_clean == "CHUUK" & county_clean %in% chuuk_outer  ~ "OUTER",
          state_clean == "YAP"   & county_clean %in% yap_main     ~ "MAIN",
          state_clean == "YAP"   & county_clean %in% yap_outer    ~ "OUTER",
          TRUE ~ region_original_clean
        ),
      TRUE ~ region_original_clean
    ),

    in_age_range = !is.na(age_months) &
      age_months >= 19 &
      age_months <= 35,

    counted_as_chuuk_outer =
      in_age_range &
      state_clean == "CHUUK" &
      region_current == "OUTER"
  )
```

```{r denom, include=FALSE}
# helper function
calc_due_pct <- function(data, age_band_name, utd_var) {
  denom <- data %>% filter(age_band == age_band_name) %>% nrow()
  if (denom == 0) return(NA_real_)

  num_due <- data %>%
    filter(age_band == age_band_name) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(.data[[utd_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(n)

  round((num_due / denom) * 100, 1)
}

  table7_rows[[length(table7_rows) + 1]] <- header_row

  sub <- dose_specs %>% filter(Vaccine == vax)

  for (i in 1:nrow(sub)) {
    this_var <- sub$var[i]
    this_dose <- sub$Dose[i]
    eligible <- sub$eligible_age_bands[[i]]

    vals <- sapply(age_levels, function(ab) {
      if (!(ab %in% eligible)) {
        "--"
      } else {
        val <- calc_due_pct(fsm_utd, ab, this_var)
        ifelse(is.na(val), "", paste0(val))
      }
    })

    row <- tibble(
      row_label = this_dose,
      `2 - 3 months (%)`   = vals[1],

      `6 - 11 months (%)`  = vals[3],
      `12 - 18 months (%)` = vals[4],
      `19 - 35 months (%)` = vals[5],
      `36 - 47 months (%)` = vals[6],
      `48 - 59 months (%)` = vals[7]
    )

    table7_rows[[length(table7_rows) + 1]] <- row
  }
}
```
